messages.content: 你被給予一個包含各種變數的資料集，包括「年齡」、「收入」、「教育」、「性別」、「婚姻狀況」和「消費分數」。你想要根據其他變數來預測「消費分數」。請問你能否使用「run_linear_regression」函數建立一個線性迴歸模型，使用「年齡」、「收入」和「教育」作為預測變數，「消費分數」作為目標變數，而不對預測變數進行標準化？然後，你能否再次運行同一個函數，但這次對預測變數進行標準化？

function.name: run_linear_regression
function.description: Build a linear regression model using given predictor variables and a target variable. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

predictors.description: Array containing the names of predictor variables.

standardize.description: Option to apply standardization on the predictors. Defaults to False.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to use the run_linear_regression function twice: first without standardization, then with standardization. They want to build a linear regression model using age, income, education as predictors, consumption score as target. They want to know if we can do it. We should call the function twice with appropriate arguments.

We need to produce two calls to the function. The function signature:

run_linear_regression({
    predictors: string[],
    target: string,
    standardize?: boolean,
})

So first call: predictors ["age", "income", "education"], target "consumption_score", standardize false (or omitted). Second call: same but standardize true.

We need to output the calls. According to guidelines, we should not provide additional text beyond the function calls. So we will produce two calls. Probably each call separately. Let's do that.
